'''Hephaestus' Lucky Dip''' is a {{Legendary}} consumable. It is unlocked from the [[Raffle of the Century]] during Year 500.

== Obtaining ==
'''Hephaestus' Lucky Dip''' is a {{Gold|'''MEDIUM'''}} reward from the Year 500 [[Raffle of the Century]].

== Usage ==
Consuming '''Hephaestus' Lucky Dip''' plays an animation and rewards the player randomly with one of the following items: 
{{DRL|
*Hephaestus' Lucky Dip
**1 Hephaestus Plushie
**1 Hephaestus Relic
**1 Hephaestus Remedies
**1 Hephaestus Souvenir
**1 Hephaestus Shelmet
**1 Hephaestus Urn}}
